note: Lakeshore CU runs MemberFirst Core v6.9.4 -- the same vendor product as Westside, rebranded, relabelled, on different route slugs, with a compliance acknowledgement after sign-on and a higher minimum opening deposit. This file is per PRODUCT+TENANT, not per capability: every capability recorded against memberfirst-core picks it up. That is the unit of reuse that makes hundreds of tenants tractable -- a tenant that rebrands is one file to edit, not one edit per recorded flow.
$comment_recoveries: Lakeshore's post-sign-on compliance acknowledgement needs NO entry here. It is handled by the product-level 'acknowledge-compliance-notice' recovery rule, because an extra mandatory screen is operationally identical to an unexpected interstitial. Modelling it as a recovery rather than as a tenant-specific step means any tenant that switches the setting on or off needs no change at all.
